'''''Leucothoe fontanesiana''''', also known as the '''highland doghobble''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=LE|taxon=Leucothoe fontanesiana|accessdate=24 January 2016}}</ref> '''fetter-bush''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> '''mountain doghobble''' or '''switch ivy''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] Ericaceae, [[native plant|native]] to the southeastern United States. It is an erect [[evergreen]] [[shrub]] growing to {{convert|1|-|2|m|ft|0|abbr=on}} tall by {{convert|3|m|ft|0|abbr=on}} broad, with laurel-like glossy leaves {{convert|6|-|16|cm|0|abbr=on}} long, and pendent axillary [[raceme]]s of urn-shaped flowers in spring.<ref name=RHSAZ>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1405332965|pages=1136}}</ref><ref>[http://www.carolinanature.com/trees/lefo.html Trees, Shrubs, and Woody Vines of North Carolina: Mountain Doghobble (''Leucothoe fontanesiana'')]</ref>

This plant is a [[calcifuge]] and requires a shaded position in acid soil. The [[cultivar]] 'Rollissonii'<ref>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Leucothoe fontanesiana'' 'Rollissonii'|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/106153/Leucothoe-fontanesiana-Rollissonii/Details | accessdate = 2 October 2020}}</ref> has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 60 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | accessdate = 22 March 2018}}</ref>

''L. fontanesiana'' has been marked as a pollinator plant, supporting and attracting bees and butterflies<ref>{{Cite web|title=Planting Guides|url=https://www.pollinator.org/pollinator.org/assets/generalFiles/OzarkBroadleafrx1FINAL_171017_085901.pdf|access-date=2022-01-29|website=Pollinator.org|language=en-US}}</ref>
